post.description: Access real-time search with Dappier's AI models — from live web search and breaking news to stock prices and financial insights. Fast, reliable, and ready for monetization.

parameters.name: ai_model_id
parameters.description: The ID of the AI model to query (e.g., am_01j06ytn18ejftedz6dyhz2b15). Browse and find AI models in the [Dappier Marketplace](https://platform.dappier.com/marketplace).

post.description: Retrieve articles based on queries or URLs, powered by semantic search.

parameters.name: data_model_id
parameters.description: Data model ID, starting with `dm_`. Browse and find data models in the [Dappier Marketplace](https://platform.dappier.com/marketplace).

query.description: Natural language query, keyword, or URL. If a URL is specified, our AI analyzes the page context, summarizes it, and provides semantic recommendations based on the content.

similarity_top_k.description: The number of articles to return.

ref.description: The site domain where AI recommendations are being displayed. Example format: dappier.com.

num_articles_ref.description: The minimum number of articles from the `ref` domain specified above. The rest of the articles will come from other sites within the RAG model.

search_algorithm.description:
The search algorithm for retrieving articles.
 `most_recent`: Retrieves the most recent articles by publication date. `semantic` (default): Retrieves contextually relevant articles based on the query or the page content from the provided URL. `most_recent_semantic`: Performs semantic search and retrieves the most recent articles by publication date. `trending`: Performs a trending search and retrieves the most relevant articles to trending keywords in the past 24 hours.

status.description: The status of the API response.

query.description: The query string used for the recommendations.

image_url.description: The image URL for the article. You can add &w=400&h=200 to the end of the URL with your desired size values to automatically resize and optimize delivery of the image.

preview_content.description: A short preview of the article content.

pubdate.description: The publication date of the article.

pubdate_unix.description: The publication date in UNIX timestamp.

score.description: The relevance score of the article.

site.description: The source site of the article.

source_url.description: The tracking URL for the article.

summary.description: A summary of the article content.

get.description: Publisher-facing Ask AI engagement rollup: summary KPIs plus a daily time-series. Numbers match the Dappier platform analytics dashboard for the same filters.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the analytics window, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC). Optional — if either `start_date` or `end_date` is omitted, both default to the trailing **7-day window** ending `today_UTC` (i.e., `start_date = today_UTC - 6`).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the analytics window, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC). Optional — if either `start_date` or `end_date` is omitted, both default to the trailing **7-day window** ending `today_UTC`. Must be on or after `start_date`; the total range must be ≤ **365 days**.

parameters.name: widget_id
parameters.description: External widget id (e.g. `wd_...`). Validated against the key's tenant — an unknown or other-tenant id returns `400 widget_id not found`. Scopes results to that widget's AI agent. Omit for all of the tenant's widgets.

parameters.name: placement_id
parameters.description: External placement id.

parameters.name: deployment_type
parameters.description: Deployment type, e.g. `brand_agent`, `sponsored_conversation`, `embed`. Omit for all.

parameters.name: creative_id
parameters.description: Publisher-supplied ad-tracking macro filter (HTML attribute on `<dappier-ask-ai-widget>`).

parameters.name: line_item_id
parameters.description: Publisher-supplied ad-tracking macro filter.

parameters.name: publisher_id
parameters.description: Publisher-supplied ad-tracking macro filter.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the analytics window, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC). Optional — if either `start_date` or `end_date` is omitted, both default to the trailing **7-day window** ending `today_UTC` (i.e., `start_date = today_UTC - 6`).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the analytics window, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC). Optional — if either `start_date` or `end_date` is omitted, both default to the trailing **7-day window** ending `today_UTC`. Must be on or after `start_date`; the total range must be ≤ **365 days**.

parameters.name: widget_id
parameters.description: Filter to one widget. Omit for all widgets the account owns.

parameters.name: placement_id
parameters.description: Filter to one placement.

parameters.name: deployment_type
parameters.description: Filter by deployment type (exact match).

parameters.name: interaction_type
parameters.description: Single value. When omitted, the service defaults to `free_form`, `automated_followup`, and `search`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Must be ≥ 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Hard max 500 — larger values are clamped down.

200.description: A page of conversation log rows, newest-first.

400.description: `page` not a positive integer, or `limit` not a positive integer.

filters.description: Echoes back only the filters you supplied in the request.

summary.description: Full 13-metric rollup for the window. The block is internally self-consistent; all percentages are rounded to 2 decimals.

widget_loads.description: Times the widget script initialized on a page.

viewable_sessions.description: Sessions where the widget entered the viewport.

engagement_queries.description: All user-originated queries — free-form, brand-agent, search, click-to-brand-agent, sponsored, automated follow-ups.

total_clicks.description: Article-body + ad + amplify + brand-agent answer + brand-agent CTA clicks.

article_clicks.description: Subset of `total_clicks` on a URL inside the AI answer body.

cta_clicks.description: Subset of `total_clicks` on a brand-agent CTA button.

avg_session_duration_seconds.description: Mean active time per engaged session (5s beacon resolution).

total_session_time_seconds.description: Sum of active time across engaged sessions.

daily_breakdown.description: Per-day subset for charting, ascending by date.

ai_agent.description: AI model display name (falls back to the raw model id if the name can't be resolved).

referring_url.description: Page the widget was loaded on.

response.example: Yes — annual plans include a 20% discount...

count.description: Total matching rows across all pages.

filters.description: Echoes back only the filters you supplied in the request.

summary.description: Rollup for the window. Internally self-consistent; percentages rounded to 2 decimals.

impressions.description: Times a sponsored prompt was rendered and visible inside a publisher's widget.

queries.description: User queries inside the sponsored conversation (`deployment_type='sponsored_conversation'`).

engagement_rate.description: `queries / sessions × 100`. Can exceed 100% (multiple queries per session).

avg_session_duration_seconds.description: Mean active time per engaged SC session (5s beacon resolution).

article_clicks.description: Subset on a URL inside the AI answer body (`sponsored_answer_click`).

cta_clicks.description: Subset on the brand-agent CTA button (`sponsored_cta_click`).

campaign_breakdown.description: Per-campaign rollup, sorted by impressions desc. `creative_ids` is the list of DSP creative IDs configured on the campaign (from campaign setup, not per-event data) — use it to cross-reference your DSP/ad-server reports.

prompt_breakdown.description: Top rows by engagement, grouped by prompt text (not prompt id). Configured sponsored prompts appear with `impressions > 0`; user-typed follow-ups inside the SC appear with `impressions == 0` and `queries > 0`. `prompt_id` is currently always `""` (reserved for a future release).

click_type_breakdown.description: One entry per click type present.

session_intelligence.description: Single aggregated payload combining six marketplace dashboard reports.

summary.description: High-level rollup over the session-engagement events in the window.

total_engaged_sessions.description: Distinct sessions that produced ≥ 1 engagement-class interaction.

total_queries.description: Total engagement-class interactions across those sessions.

average_queries_per_session.description: `total_queries / total_engaged_sessions`, rounded to 1 decimal. `0` when there are no sessions.

max_queries_in_session.description: The most engagement queries observed in any single session in the window.

engagement_time.description: Time-on-widget metrics derived from engagement beacon events (5s beacon interval).

total_session_time_seconds.description: Sum of all session engagement time (`beacon_count × 5s`) across sessions with ≥ 1 beacon.

average_engagement_time_per_session_seco.description: Mean engagement time per engaged session, rounded to the nearest second.

median_engagement_time_per_session_secon.description: Median engagement time per engaged session. Computed via `APPROX_QUANTILES(…, 2)[OFFSET(1)]`.

sessions_with_engagement.description: Count of sessions that produced at least one `engagement_beacon` event in the window.

intent_breakdown.description: Distribution of distinct sessions across detected user intents. A session contributes once per distinct intent it expressed.

sessions.description: Distinct sessions that surfaced this intent.

percentage.description: Share of total intent-tagged sessions, rounded.

top_queried_topics.description: Top 10 unique prompts (by count) over the window, normalized for case and whitespace.

query.example: the iht loophole the wealthy don't talk about

category.description: First topic label associated with the prompt (`topic_labels[OFFSET(0)]`). Empty string when none exists.

count.description: Number of times this normalized prompt was issued.

category_distribution.description: Distribution of engagement queries across IAB content categories. A single query that touches multiple categories contributes to each (via `UNNEST(iabcontent_names)`).

count.description: Number of engagement queries tagged with the category.

percentage.description: Share of total tagged queries, rounded.

session_engagement_distribution.description: Fixed, ordered list of seven query-depth buckets. Always returned in this exact order: `"1"`, `"2"`, `"3"`, `"4"`, `"5"`, `"6-10"`, `"10+"`.

sessions.description: Sessions whose total query count falls in this bucket.

percentage.description: Share of `total_engaged_sessions` that fall in this bucket, rounded.

ApiKeyBearer.description: Bearer token authentication using your Dappier API key. Get your API key at https://platform.dappier.com/profile/api-keys.
